1 · Score board

Who scores best, and why

Nine criteria scored 0 to 10 per car (scoring v2.1); six carry weight by default. Tap More on a row for input → rule → score.

    Total = 10 × Σ(weight × score) / Σ(weight) over criteria with weight above 0, at full precision; rounded only for display. A missing input scores 4 and is marked estimate. No price, or missing inputs worth more than 30% of the weight: incomplete, not ranked. No seat-fit grade for that generation: not eligible.

    Weights start at the family's v2.1 ruling (seat fit 25, 6-yr cost 35, reliability 15, safety 15, service 10, winter 10; energy display only; ride and cargo optional at 0).
